mission: file path; line number; remediation advice

findings.issue: Unauthenticated browser RCE/SSRF via navigate/execute actions
findings.remediation: Add checkOperator() + checkRateLimit('playwright', 20) at top of POST; allowlist navigate URLs

findings.issue: Unauthenticated 50MB arbitrary file write to agent_work/uploads/
findings.remediation: Add checkOperator() + checkRateLimit('upload', 30); add binary extension blocklist (.exe, .bat, .ps1, .scr, .vbs)

findings.issue: Cookie spoofing — any LAN caller can set purpclaw_operator=Ted and claim 'founder' role for 1 year
findings.remediation: Add checkOperator() to POST; drop maxAge to 86400; add httpOnly, sameSite=lax, secure

findings.issue: Lane config mutation with no operator auth — cost amplification via provider swap
findings.remediation: Add checkOperator() + checkRateLimit('providers', 10); validate provider against sentinel.listKnownProviders()

findings.issue: smokeTest makes real provider calls with no operator auth — cost amplification
findings.remediation: Add checkOperator() + checkRateLimit('models-smoke', 10); confirm SpendGate 402 path in sentinel

findings.issue: Session tampering — any caller can read/overwrite/delete any session by ID; no per-operator scoping
findings.remediation: Add checkOperator() to all 4 handlers; scope session IDs per operator cookie; add checkRateLimit('sessions', 60) to POST

findings.issue: Trace injection — any caller can inject arbitrary trace events with arbitrary source/action/status
findings.remediation: Add checkOperator() + checkRateLimit('trace-write', 30); allowlist fields {route, action, status, detail, source}

findings.issue: eval('require') — code smell, not a vulnerability (literal string, no user input)
findings.remediation: Replace with createRequire(import.meta.url) or configure webpack externals

findings.issue: Read-only intent search, no auth — acceptable for local-first; gate POST only if exposed beyond 127.0.0.1
findings.remediation: No action required under current threat model
